description: Returns a published catalog part, its catalog ID and verified pad IDs. Use a catalog ID from search_parts when needed pins or facts are missing; use search_parts to find alternatives. factQuery and factOffset select or page cached datasheet facts. An optional boardId applies that board’s strict Part List restriction, when enabled. Guest access uses guestToken and excludes organization access.

boardId.description: Optional saved board ID. Enforces that board’s strict Part List when enabled; omit to use the full published catalog.

factOffset.description: Zero-based fact offset; defaults to 0. Continue with datasheetFacts.nextFactOffset and the same factQuery.

factQuery.description: Terms selecting relevant cached datasheet facts for this part; omit for the default fact bundle.

guestToken.description: Private guest-session capability returned by start_guest_session. Never print it or save it in a repository.

id.description: Exact published catalog ID returned by search_parts.

name: get_part
title: Get part and pins
